name: Gazprom dobycha Orenburg
note: The club's own site lists OOO «Газпром добыча Оренбург» as the general sponsor of FC Orenburg (fcorenburg.ru/club/istoriya.html, fact box). A 2 August 2026 RPL match photo (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0, via fc-zenit.ru) shows the company's logo on the shorts of the 2026/27 home kit, but no checkable text source names it as a shirt sponsor, so it is not yet placed on the kit record. Tier proposal for a maintainer: serious — the Russian state controls Gazprom (gazprom-state-control), Gazprom owns 100% of Gazprom dobycha Orenburg (gdo-gazprom-subsidiary), and Russia has been at war with Ukraine since February 2022 (russian-federation-record).
